blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Senate minority leader Alan Peter Cayetano on Friday hit back at Sen. Panfilo “Ping” Lacson over the latter’s latest allegations of continuous “illegal reclamation” on the Taguig side of Laguna Lake. Cayetano said he appears to be the one to blame for whatever happens in the city. “I am always the one being referred to,” he said in a Facebook livestream on Friday. “And whatever happens in Taguig, it is already my fault. Even though Taguig is a very large city and has 1.3 million Taguigeños,” the senator said. Cayetano was responding to Lacson’s post earlier Friday showing […]...
